action.new_text:
"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Input validation
    if not isinstance(logp_with_result, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_call_only, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_no_call, np.ndarray):
        raise ValueError("inputs must be numpy arrays")
    if logp_with_result.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("inputs must be 2D matrices")
    if logp_with_result.shape != logp_call_only.shape or logp_with_result.shape != logp_no_call.shape:
        raise ValueError("inputs must have the same shape")
    if logp_with_result.shape[0] == 0 or logp_with_result.shape[1] == 0:
        raise ValueError("inputs must not be empty matrices")
    if not np.isfinite(logp_with_result).all() or not np.isfinite(logp_call_only).all() or not np.isfinite(logp_no_call).all():
        raise ValueError("inputs must be finite")
    if (logp_with_result > 0).any() or (logp_call_only > 0).any() or (logp_no_call > 0).any():
        raise ValueError("inputs must be nonpositive")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be numeric")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite nonnegative")

    future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape[1]
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    L_with = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    L_no_call = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)

    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)
    margin = L_minus - L_with
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
